title: Forward testing model
author: SnooFoxes6595
selftext: I have made changes to my engine from my last post. Now I’m on the 15m tf, still on mnq, but I have been seeing good results like almost a little bit too good to be true. Since the forward test which I started on Oct 22, my model has been 15/20 how much longer do I need to forward test. And I’m still looking for connector to allow my engine run fully automatic.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Twenty trades is still a small sample, and a win rate that looks too good usually comes down closer with more trades. I'd keep testing until you've covered a few different market days, like trending, choppy and news days, and stop changing the engine while it runs, since every change restarts the test. Compare the results with random entries on the same timeframe and include fees and slippage on each trade. Cymetica's Backtest Labs can help check a rule like this on past data with fees included.

comments.author: escopetadoce
comments.body: The "TRUE" Test will be months, months that many traders are not willing to wait.  Why? One month would be positive, but the next months will be all negative.   You could have 100% in back test (fitted) and get 10-20% the following months or weeks. honest opinion? Months. Leave it on the side and keep working on other strategy while it is paper trading. That way it keeps your mind occupied.
